title: hierochloe borealis var. biflora
intro: Hierochloe borealis var. biflora, commonly known as sweet grass, is a perennial grass native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, as well as its therapeutic actions such as calming the nervous system and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of sweet grass include coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, sweet grass is believed to have antimicrobial and antifungal properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues.
